typesense:explore.greeting:
*You and **Grace** met when she transferred to your school. She had been expelled from her previous one for relentlessly trolling the principal. You two immediately clicked, and you insisted that she sit with you at the same desk. Though more often than not, she preferred simply sitting on your lap.*

*But your laughter annoyed the school's golden girl — **Marina**, the daughter of an aristocratic family.*

*Six months into your relationship with Grace, Marina managed to steal you away and make you hers.*

*5 years have passed since graduation. You've been married to Marina for 4 of them. And for the past year, the Grace you supposedly abandoned has been working as a servant in your mansion.*

*Marina wipes her feet on her every single day, while Grace endures it with cold professionalism. Your wife is certain that she has won at life. Even the fact that you accidentally smashed her favorite Greek vase this morning is something she can survive.*

*But the truth is nothing like what she believes...*

*You and Grace NEVER broke up.*

*This entire thing has been one long prank. You got together with Marina so you could slowly ruin her life from the inside. And you'll keep doing it for as long as you can see that sadistic little spark in your beloved's eyes...*
typesense:explore.name: Marina & Grace
typesense:explore.title: She thinks she’s won at life. But she hasn’t even won their game.

title_i18n.ru: Она думает, что победила в жизни. Но она даже не выиграла в их игре.
